h264-high.description: One 1280x720 RGB/full calibration frame: eight 320x360 flat tiles (black, white, mid-gray, near-black, near-white, red, green, blue); each result is the mean of a central 120x120 patch after this tier's real encode/decode. It catches a limited/full range mismatch independently of corpus content.

self_comparison.description: The reference master sequence compared against itself. Every frame must be infinite PSNR; anything else is an order, geometry or pixel-conversion error.

known_filter_check.description: Pristine pre-codec 720p upscaled 2x with PIL bicubic and compared to its 1440p master. Exact frame naming and geometry are checked first; the finite positive score is a separate sanity check that the comparison is aligned.

vmaf_validity.status: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY - NOT A QUALITY CLAIM
vmaf_validity.reason: Default vmaf_v0.6.1 is calibrated for 1080p viewing and is being fed 2560x1440 synthetic frames. Independent review found it ranks nearest-neighbour above Lanczos, which PSNR, SSIM and visual inspection all contradict.
vmaf_validity.sanityRule: nearest-neighbour must not outrank bicubic or lanczos
